name: Tear of the Moons
summary: At Bael Modan in the southern Barrens, dwarven excavators have unearthed the Tear of the Moons. Its strange power draws Feegly into obsession, while General Twinbraid fears what the crystal can do.

sections.title: A Unearthed Relic
sections.body: Dwarven excavators unearthed the Tear of the Moons during the first digging at Bael Modan. The crystal's strange radiance captivated the miners, especially Feegly. He claimed it gave him great strength, then grew unstable and turned against his comrades. General Twinbraid, commander of the expedition, feared the relic's influence and declared it cursed. He took the crystal and locked it in his personal strongbox at Bael'dun Keep. Then he cast Feegly out into the Barrens.

sections.title: The Price of Obsession
sections.body: Exiled Feegly cannot master his craving for the crystal's power. He asks passing Horde travelers to help break into the dwarven fortress and take it from Twinbraid's vault. When Feegly gets the Tear and rubs it, strange grunts escape him. The crystal falls from his hands and shatters on the ground. Feegly turns into a trogg and dies shortly afterward.

faq.q: Where did the Tear of the Moons come from?
faq.answer: Dwarven Prospectors and excavators unearthed the Tear of the Moons at Bael Modan, an archaeological dig site in the southern Barrens.

faq.q: Why was the crystal locked inside Bael'dun Keep?
faq.answer: General Twinbraid feared the crystal was cursed after Feegly grew obsessed with it and turned against his fellow miners. He locked it in his strongbox at Bael'dun Keep to protect the expedition.

faq.q: What happens when Feegly gets the Tear back?
faq.answer: Feegly rubs the crystal, which falls from his hands and shatters. He turns into a trogg and dies shortly afterward.

faq.q: Can the Tear of the Moons be saved or repaired?
faq.answer: The Tear shatters when Feegly gets it back. The account gives no word of anyone repairing it afterward.

angles.text: As a dwarf, Feegly's fate warns of the danger the Bael'dun expedition risks waking beneath Kalimdor.
As a member of the Horde, you help recover the relic from Bael'dun Keep, disrupting the Ironforge military presence encroaching on ancestral tauren lands.
